verdict.rationale: Apple ships a real NPU (16-core Neural Engine plus GPU Neural Accelerators) with mature, shipping-today SDKs/runtimes — Core ML, Metal Performance Shaders, Metal 4 Tensor APIs, and the open-source MLX framework are all documented as available now. However, the evidence pack contains no published TOPS figure (with precision stated) for the Neural Engine or Neural Accelerators, which is an explicit requirement of the story. Missing for 10: an official published TOPS number with precision (e.g., INT8/FP16) for the M5 Neural Engine/Neural Accelerators.
